doc.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Playing Sweet Basil and around; Jimmy Heath says no more vamps
summary: His working mix after Vegas included Sweet Basil, Washington, Canada, recordings, and Jimmy Heath's "no more vamps".

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: I'm going to slide you back -­
Sure!
-- coming out of Vegas and going back to New York City. The quartet that you had at that time, now, did you pretty much stay in the New York City area? That was a group you toured a lot, wasn't it?

No. What I did was I played -- we played -- we op -- we played at the Sweet Basil. Okay? And then I did -- you know, played the Sweet Basil, I did some things with Clyde [phonetic sp.] and -- and his -- his concert band thing that he had.
Was that the World of Trombones or was that something else?
No, no. Different band.
This was a different band?

Different band with a lot of different people in it. And then I'd -- then I would go to Washington, D.C. and do something as a single. And I'd do the Left Bank Jazz Society [phonetic sp.], you know. Things like that.
Lots of different things?
Yeah. I'd go to Canada and work up at the club up there, you know, like that. Uh-huh.
[affirmative]
And -- and then you were back off and on with Dizzy, also, across that -­
Oh, yeah!
-- time?
And then, like, Diz would do something or something and I'd go and do something with him and then I'd, you know. Go back to my thing or do a kind of concert. I'd do, you know.
You were doing quite a lot of recording around this time, too, weren't you? Isn't this -­ is this the vintage of Heritage Home and some of those things, or?

I did some of that too, yeah. Yeah. Somewhere around there, yeah. But it was nice, though, because, like, Section [phonetic sp.] heard me doing something and Section says, "Yeah, no more vamps! No more vamps!"
[laughs]
You know what a vamp is? A vamp is when you go [scatting]. There's no change, I mean, you just play on that one thing. Section said, "No more vamps!" You know. [scatting]
[scatting]
You know what I mean? [laughs] Yeah.
You might want to tell 'em who you're talking about, too.
Oh, Section is Jimmy Heep [phonetic sp.]. We call it The Section because it's saxophone section. Yeah, that's who that is, my buddy, boy. Yeah.
